archive: git clone https://github.com/fluffos/nightmare3 (not a traditional archive file — a maintained, already FluffOS-adapted fork; mudlib root is the repo's lib/ directory)
name: Nightmare 3
english_description: One of the oldest and most historically influential LPMud mudlib families, an ancestor of the TMI-2 lineage. This fork (fluffos/nightmare3) is already updated for modern FluffOS. New characters pick a race in a genesis void room before rolling stats and entering Praxis, the mudlib's own shipped example domain built around a central town square. Unlike the rest of this collection, content is in English, included deliberately for its historical importance to the wider LPMud family tree.
